recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "A crowdsourced map of a strange country", "body": "Mark Steeves came on to talk about Esoteric America, the new show he launched with Chad Stemke after recording five episodes before releasing any of them. The premise is that listeners, not experts, should be the guests. Mark tells Chance Garton he can only speak for Connecticut, so he wants local researchers everywhere filling in the map with mounds, native history, Tartaria, colonial history and oddities like the one footed snorkel monster. He points to Andrea breaking down Baudette, Minnesota and Jack Asgard breaking down the Inland Empire as the model for what the show is trying to build."}, {"title": "What S.E.E.E.N. actually asks you to do", "body": "The pamphlet Mark wrote stands for the Synchromistic Exploration of the Ever Expanding Now, and he frames it as a travel guide to wherever you already are. It grew out of his frustration with the Randonautica app, which never worked in an area with no phone service. The kit is a pair of dice, a compass, a map, a notebook and pen, a camera, a backpack and a cup. The cup holds the dice so you can shake them while driving, with odds meaning left and evens meaning right, provoking randomness until you are genuinely lost."}, {"title": "Dreamwalking instead of sleepwalking", "body": "Mark argues that most of us are sleepwalkers and that dreamwalking is the deliberate opposite, a way of waking up to a reality that is always there the way dreams are. He believes the land itself carries an energetic imprint from the people who lived here for thousands of years, and that those layers sit under only four hundred years of newer history like soil turned over by a farmer. You can connect with ancestors who share no genealogy with you, he says, through the dirt, the plants, the animals and the common ground you both stand on."}, {"title": "Why the psychedelic push looks suspicious", "body": "Chance raises the question of why psychedelics are suddenly being moved into pharmaceutical and psychiatric territory, and suggests a hyper materialistic culture is grabbing them as another experience to collect. Mark answers that science is trying to quantify spirituality by breaking plants down into molecules, and speculates the real goal is finding a chemical bridge into augmented digital reality, noting synthetic compounds are easier to program. His stronger claim is that people have it backwards. The experience is in you and the mushroom only activates it. He compares his book to a swing set next to the roller coaster of ayahuasca."}, {"title": "Breaking routine, gratitude and omens", "body": "The practical heart of the conversation is that our problems live inside our routines, so stepping out of the daily pie chart of hours creates room to see them. Mark asks people to set aside real time, express gratitude, and log every object, omen and occurrence, because a pattern surfaces after a few outings. He teaches a walking meditation of matching steps to breath, and describes the drifting state you enter while driving as a doorway to synchronicity. Chance closes with the copy of The Alchemist by Paulo Coelho that reached him in Chicago days after he asked for it."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Mark Steeves, host and co-host of many epic podcasts, including his flagship show My Family Thinks I'm Crazy, returns to InnerVerse to talk about his new projects, Esoteric America and S.E.E.E.N. Mark is quickly becoming a leader in the world of synchromystic explorations, connecting to Gaia consciousness, and of course, the conspiracy & spirituality that we love to research.
